title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
note: IPC 498A combines the offence, punishment and an explanation defining cruelty. BNS separates these into section 85 (offence and punishment) and section 86 (definition). The accused must be the husband or a relative of the husband and must subject the woman to cruelty within at least one statutory branch. Both central provisions prescribe imprisonment up to three years and liability to fine. Section 86 is a definition for section 85, not a separately punishable offence.
